title: MediaWiki Code2Code Search: Neural Retrieval for the Semantic Discovery of Open-Source Software Entities
abstract: arXiv:2607.26766v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Code search in large-scale ecosystems is often hindered by the lexical gap between user queries and implementation details, alongside the trade-off between the low latency of traditional Information Retrieval (IR) and the precision of Deep Learning (DL). We present MediaWiki Code2Code Search, a neural retrieval system for semantic code-to-code discovery. By indexing 1.29 million structural entities (functions, types, and templates) across 2,500+ MediaWiki repositories, our system enables retrieval based on computational intent rather than surface tokens. We employ a split-build architecture, decoupling GPU-intensive offline indexing from a CPU-only serving layer; our FAISS IVF-PQ index occupies 168.6 MiB: a 96.6\% reduction compared to a flat float32 baseline, and achieves a median query latency of 1.85 seconds on commodity hardware, satisfying the 6 GiB RAM constraint of Wikimedia Toolforge. translated_title: MediaWiki代码到代码搜索：用于开源软件实体语义发现的神经检索
translated_abstract: 大规模生态系统中的代码搜索常常受到用户查询与实现细节之间词汇鸿沟的阻碍，同时还面临传统信息检索（IR）的低延迟与深度学习（DL）的精确性之间的权衡问题。我们提出了MediaWiki Code2Code Search，一个用于语义化代码到代码发现的神经检索系统。通过索引2500多个MediaWiki代码库中的129万个结构化实体（函数、类型和模板），我们的系统能够基于计算意图而非表面词元进行检索。我们采用分离构建架构，将GPU密集型的离线索引与仅使用CPU的服务层解耦；我们的FAISS IVF-PQ索引仅占用168.6 MiB空间，相比扁平float32基线减少了96.6%，并在普通硬件上实现了1.85秒的中位查询延迟，满足了Wikimedia Toolforge的6 GiB内存限制。在一项由...进行的盲测评估中（原文此处不完整）
tldr: 本文提出了MediaWiki Code2Code Search神经检索系统，通过FAISS IVF-PQ索引实现对2500多个代码库中129万个代码实体的语义化代码到代码搜索，在满足6 GiB内存限制的同时实现了96.6%的索引空间压缩和1.85秒的中位查询延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MediaWiki Code2Code Search, a neural retrieval system enabling semantic code-to-code discovery across 1.29 million entities in 2,500+ MediaWiki repositories, achieving 96.6% index compression and 1.85-second median query latency while satisfying the 6 GiB RAM constraint of Wikimedia Toolforge.
